description: Replace single global macro goal with named per-day goal profiles. Users create unlimited profiles (Training Day, Rest Day, etc.), assign each weekday to a profile, and the dashboard auto-selects the active profile based on today's day of week. Old MacroGoalsSettings + MacroGoalsDialog retired and replaced.

userStories.title: MacroGoalProfile schema + repository
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to persist named macro goal profiles and weekday mappings in the local database so they survive app restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: New macro_goal_profile table: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, protein_g REAL NOT NULL, carbs_g REAL NOT NULL, fat_g REAL NOT NULL, calories_kcal REAL NOT NULL
New weekday_goal_mapping table: weekday INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (0=Mon…6=Sun), profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES macro_goal_profile(id)
Migration 6.sqm in db/migrations/ creates both tables
MacroGoalProfile domain model in data/model/ with fields: id Long, name String, proteinG Double, carbsG Double, fatG Double, caloriesKcal Double

MacroGoalRepository interface in data/repository/: getAllProfiles(): Flow<List<MacroGoalProfile>>, addProfile(name, protein, carbs, fat, calories): Long, updateProfile(id, name, protein, carbs, fat, calories), deleteProfile(id), getMappingForWeekday(weekday: Int): Long? (returns profileId or null), setMappingForWeekday(weekday: Int, profileId: Long), getActiveProfileForDate(date: String): MacroGoalProfile

MacroGoalRepositoryImpl backed by SQLDelight, all ops on Dispatchers.Default; getActiveProfileForDate computes weekday via dayOfWeekMonBased(), looks up mapping row, falls back to first profile named 'Default' if no mapping exists
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64

userStories.title: Seed migration — existing goal → Default profile
userStories.description: As a user upgrading the app, I want my existing macro goal preserved as a profile named Default so I don't lose my current targets.
acceptanceCriteria: MacroGoalRepositoryImpl.seedDefaultIfEmpty() reads current protein/carbs/fat/calories from UserSettingsDataSource and inserts a profile named 'Default' if the macro_goal_profile table is empty
seedDefaultIfEmpty() called from App.kt once after MacroGoalRepositoryImpl is instantiated (inside a LaunchedEffect or coroutine scope)
Idempotent: if profile table already has rows, seed is skipped entirely
No weekday mapping rows are inserted during seed — getActiveProfileForDate falls back to the Default profile via name lookup when no mapping row exists
UserSettingsDataSource macro goal getters/setters remain untouched (no deletes, no renames)
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64

userStories.title: MacroProfilesStateHolder + Settings profile list
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see all my macro goal profiles listed in Settings so I can manage them in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: MacroProfilesState data class: profiles: List<MacroGoalProfile>, weekdayMappings: Map<Int, Long> (weekday → profileId)
MacroProfilesStateHolder in ui/settings/ receives MacroGoalRepository + CoroutineScope; exposes StateFlow<MacroProfilesState>; combines getAllProfiles() flow with weekday mapping reads reactively

New 'Macro Profiles' section in the Settings screen replaces the existing MacroGoalsSettings section; renders a list of ElevatedCard items (one per profile): title = profile name (titleMedium), subtitle = 'P: Xg · C: Xg · F: Xg · X kcal' (bodySmall, MiTextSecondary)
MacroGoalsSettings.kt file deleted
'+ Add Profile' button at the bottom of the profile list opens the add-profile sheet (wired in US-004 — no-op lambda placeholder for now)
Tapping a profile card calls an onEditProfile(MacroGoalProfile) lambda (no-op placeholder for now)
MacroProfilesStateHolder and MacroGoalRepositoryImpl wired in App.kt via remember {}
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64

userStories.title: Add / edit / delete profile dialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want to create, rename, and delete macro goal profiles so I can maintain exactly the set I need.
acceptanceCriteria: MacroProfileSheet composable (ModalBottomSheet, RoundedCornerShape topStart/topEnd 32.dp, same style as CardioLogSheet): fields = name OutlinedTextField, protein/carbs/fat OutlinedTextField (KeyboardType.Number), calories displayed as read-only computed Text using MacroMath.caloriesFromMacros()
Save validates: name non-blank, protein >= 0, carbs >= 0, fat >= 0; shows inline error text per field otherwise
Edit mode (non-null profile passed in): pre-fills all fields; shows 'Delete' TextButton (colorScheme.error)
Delete calls stateHolder.deleteProfile(id); if profile is assigned to any weekday mapping, show a Snackbar 'Unassign from all days first' and do NOT delete
Save calls stateHolder.addProfile() or stateHolder.updateProfile(); StateFlow updates immediately
onEditProfile and onAddProfile lambdas wired in Settings screen to show/hide the sheet via showSheet + selectedProfile state
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64

userStories.title: Weekly Schedule — weekday-to-profile assignment
userStories.description: As a user, I want to assign a macro goal profile to each day of the week so the app knows which targets to apply automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Below the profile list in the 'Macro Profiles' Settings section, a 'Weekly Schedule' header followed by 7 rows: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun (0=Mon…6=Sun using dayOfWeekMonBased convention)
Each row: day label on the left, ExposedDropdownMenuBox on the right listing all profile names from state.profiles
Currently mapped profile shown as selected; days with no mapping row show the 'Default' profile name selected (visual default only — no DB row written until user explicitly picks)
Selecting a profile calls stateHolder.setMapping(weekday, profileId) which persists immediately and updates StateFlow
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64

userStories.title: Dashboard reads active profile
userStories.description: As a user, I want the dashboard macro counters and summary card to automatically reflect the goal profile assigned to today's weekday.
acceptanceCriteria: MacroSummaryCard and MacroDailyCounterDetail receive active MacroGoalProfile (protein, carbs, fat, calories) instead of reading from UserSettingsDataSource directly
Active profile resolved via MacroGoalRepository.getActiveProfileForDate(selectedDate) — called in DashboardStateHolder or passed down from App.kt
MacroSummaryCard shows the active profile name as a subtitle (bodySmall, MiTextSecondary) below the macro progress bars
Changing the date navigator to a different weekday re-evaluates and shows that day's profile targets
MacroGoalsDialog in MacroDailyCounterDetail.kt removed (dead code deleted); any 'Edit Goals' button wired to navigate to Settings instead or removed
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
